title: Practice 2: The family of писа́ть (письмо, писа́тель)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **надпись** — на́дпись: inscription, writing, label; dedication (on a book); address (on an envelope); legend (on a coin, medal, map). Wiktionary: надписа́ть + -ь.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

pairs: to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: писа́ние — writing, script, scripture; записа́ть — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); за́пись — record, recording (e.g. sound); на́дпись — inscription, writing, label.
